tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background behind everything (refs 11, 12).

tokens.name: ground-document
tokens.usage: Background of a document or plan page (refs 13, 16).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, tiles, fields and rows set on the ground (refs 12, 15, 17).

tokens.name: surface-floating
tokens.usage: Glass, 78% opaque and blurred behind: controls that float over content: top buttons, the capsule, the tab bar, the round button (refs 11, 12).

tokens.name: surface-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets, frosted: 88% opaque and blurred (ref 13).

tokens.name: surface-popover
tokens.usage: Popover menus, frosted white (ref 17).

tokens.name: fill
tokens.usage: Chips, date chips and the search capsule (refs 11, 12).

tokens.name: chip-icon
tokens.usage: Icons in unselected chips (ref 12); 7.6:1 on fill.

tokens.name: checkbox-fill
tokens.usage: Inside an empty checkbox (ref 12).

tokens.name: segment-on
tokens.usage: A selected segment or tool in a sheet, with an accent-select edge (ref 13).

tokens.name: fill-sheet
tokens.usage: Tool buttons and soft buttons inside a sheet (ref 13).

tokens.name: fill-selected
tokens.usage: The pill behind the selected tab (ref 11).

tokens.name: separator
tokens.usage: Inset hairlines between rows on the ground (ref 11).

tokens.name: separator-surface
tokens.usage: Hairlines on white cards and sheets (ref 16).

tokens.name: separator-sheet
tokens.usage: Dividers and button edges inside a sheet (refs 15, 17).

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: One-point card edge when a card needs one (ref 12).

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Checkbox and radio rings (refs 12, 13). Non-text, 3:1 is not required for a decorative ring beside a label.

tokens.name: close
tokens.usage: The round close button in a popover header (ref 14).

tokens.name: grabber
tokens.usage: The 36 by 4 handle on a sheet (refs 13, 15).

tokens.name: text-1
tokens.usage: Titles, headings and row text; 15.2:1 on ground.

tokens.name: text-1-soft
tokens.usage: Task text and card titles; 11.8:1 on surface.

tokens.name: text-2
tokens.usage: Captions, chip labels and any secondary WORDS; 4.7:1 on ground, 5.2:1 on surface. The references sample #7e8084 to #87898d here, which is 3.6:1, so words use this darker value.

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: Outline icons, placeholders and the search glass (refs 11, 12). Not for words on its own: 3.6:1 on ground.

tokens.name: text-3
tokens.usage: Dots, the collapse chevron and other quiet marks. Never words.

tokens.name: text-4
tokens.usage: Counts beside a row and disabled marks. Never words that matter.

tokens.name: button-black
tokens.usage: The Done capsule (refs 13, 16); its label is on-black.

tokens.name: on-black
tokens.usage: Label on button-black; 15.9:1.

tokens.name: button-grey
tokens.usage: Cancel capsule in a pair (ref 17).

tokens.name: on-grey
tokens.usage: Label on button-grey; 6.6:1.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one hue: Apply, the selected tab icon, badges. Darkened from the references' #3a85f6 so white labels reach 4.8:1.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Label on accent.

tokens.name: accent-select
tokens.usage: Selection marks: the Now bar, radio dot, the check (refs 12, 13). A mark, not text.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Text buttons such as Reset (ref 13). Darkened from #0a80d7 (4.1:1) to reach 5.2:1.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Background of a selected chip (ref 12).

tokens.name: accent-tint-edge
tokens.usage: Thin edge of a selected chip.

tokens.name: accent-on-tint
tokens.usage: Label of a selected chip; 6.3:1 on accent-tint.

tokens.name: now-block
tokens.usage: The selected block: Now on the plan (ref 13).

tokens.name: now-halo
tokens.usage: The soft halo around the Now block.

tokens.name: now-text
tokens.usage: Title inside the Now block; 4.7:1 on now-block.

tokens.name: bell-filled
tokens.usage: The filled bell when something waits for the owner (ref 11).

tokens.name: selection-frame
tokens.usage: Frame around a selected card (ref 12).

tokens.name: groove
tokens.usage: The timeline's track, pressed into the page: the trunk and every branch (owner, 15 Nov 2026: option 4, groove).

tokens.name: groove-edge
tokens.usage: The light lower edge of a groove drawn as a line (a branch), where an inner shadow cannot go.

tokens.name: groove-main
tokens.usage: Main's groove, a shade darker than a branch's and 8 wide, so main stands out (owner, 15 Nov 2026: lane option C).

tokens.name: main-mark
tokens.usage: The disc behind an event icon on main; branch icons stay on fill.

tokens.name: on-main-mark
tokens.usage: The icon on a main-mark disc; 11:1.

tokens.name: groove-fill
tokens.usage: Fills the groove for work that is done, like a slider's fill.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dims the page behind a sheet or popover (refs 14, 15, 17).

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", system-ui, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", sans-serif

groups.name: Text
groups.note: The system font, as the references use. Sizes are points read as px.

styles.name: large-title
styles.usage: One per screen, 16 from the left; scrolls with the page.

styles.name: document-title
styles.usage: The title of a plan or document page.

styles.name: section-heading
styles.usage: Names a group of rows; a chevron follows the word.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Capsule buttons, selected chips, card titles.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Under a card title or row; text-2.

styles.name: chip
styles.usage: Chip and date-chip text, tile labels.

styles.name: caps-label
styles.usage: Group label inside a sheet, upper case.

spacing.note: Read from the references in points. 16 is the screen margin; 8 is the gap between chips and cards.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Hairline offsets.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Icon to dot; the Now bar width.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between the two capsules of a pair.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between chips and between cards.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Sheet inset from the screen sides; between pinned cards.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Screen margin; row padding.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Tab bar from the left edge.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Separator stop from the right; between sections.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Above a large title, below the last section.

radius.note: Round, soft and capsule-shaped; nothing square.

tokens.name: radius-4
tokens.usage: Checkbox.

tokens.name: radius-6
tokens.usage: Date chip.

tokens.name: radius-10
tokens.usage: Fields, tool buttons, choice tiles.

tokens.name: radius-12
tokens.usage: Document cards and tiles.

tokens.name: radius-16
tokens.usage: Pinned and project cards.

tokens.name: radius-28
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and popovers.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Capsules, chips, the tab bar, round buttons.

shadow.note: Soft and wide; floating controls lift, rows never do.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Top buttons, the capsule, the tab bar, the round button.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Tiles and cards that sit on the ground.

tokens.name: shadow-chip
tokens.usage: Unselected chips: a light top edge, a darker bottom edge and a small drop, so they read as raised (owner, 15 Nov: the chips were missing 'that slight element of shadow').

tokens.name: shadow-chip-selected
tokens.usage: The selected chip: a white top edge, a rim darker at the bottom and a soft drop below, as in ref 12.

tokens.name: shadow-groove
tokens.usage: Presses the timeline's track into the page: a soft inner shadow and a light lower edge, the opposite of shadow-chip.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Sheets and popovers.

size.note: Fixed control sizes from the references, in points.

tokens.name: size-hit
tokens.usage: Top circle buttons, capsule height, search height.

tokens.name: size-chip
tokens.usage: Filter chip height.

tokens.name: size-row
tokens.usage: List row pitch.

tokens.name: size-row-menu
tokens.usage: Popover row pitch.

tokens.name: size-tabbar
tokens.usage: Tab bar height.

tokens.name: size-round
tokens.usage: The separate round action button.

tokens.name: size-capsule
tokens.usage: Done capsule height.
